name: Redactis — AI Content Generator & SEO Writer
author: TudoInfoRJ

sections.description:
Redactis is a professional, autonomous AI-powered editorial assistant and content generator built for WordPress. It helps bloggers, digital agencies, and content creators discover trending topics, draft structured outlines, generate in-depth SEO-optimized articles, and review existing content directly inside the WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg).

🚀 Key Features

  • Two-Step Editorial Workflow: Generate fast, structured outlines (Title, SEO Slug, Focus Keyword, Category, Tags, and Table of Contents) before producing the full article.
  • Multi-Provider AI Engine: Connect directly with your choice of AI providers using your own API keys:
    • Google Gemini (Free Tier supported: Gemini 2.5 Flash, 3.5 Flash, 3.6 Flash)
    • Groq LPU (Ultra-fast inference: Llama 3.3 70B, Llama 3.1)
    • DeepSeek (DeepSeek V3, DeepSeek R1)
    • OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o Mini, GPT-4.1)
    • Anthropic Claude (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku)
  • Real-Time Trend Radar: Monitor daily trending topics from Google Trends (BR) and Google News, with custom query filters for your niche.
  • Gutenberg Interactive AI Review: Review and enhance existing posts with AI-driven readability improvements, internal linking suggestions, and conversion CTAs with preview/approval before applying.
  • Complete SEO Metadata: Automatically generates Yoast SEO / Rank Math compatible focus keywords, meta titles, meta descriptions, and post excerpts.
  • Custom Brand Styling & CTAs: Configure your brand colors and WhatsApp conversion numbers to automatically format call-to-action boxes.
  • Automated Morning Drafts (WP-Cron): Optional daily automated cron job to draft new posts based on trending morning news.
  • Transparent System Logs: Built-in diagnostic log viewer with security masking for sensitive API credentials.

Third-Party Services & Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to external third-party APIs to generate text content and fetch trending news. By configuring API keys in this plugin, you agree to the respective provider terms:

  • Google Gemini API (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com): Used for content generation and text processing.

    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  • Groq Cloud API (https://api.groq.com): Used for ultra-fast Llama model inference.

    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  • DeepSeek API (https://api.deepseek.com): Used for DeepSeek V3/R1 content generation.

    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  • OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com): Used for GPT-4o / GPT-4.1 generation.

    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  • Anthropic Claude API (https://api.anthropic.com): Used for Claude models.

    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  • Google Trends & Google News Public RSS (https://trends.google.com, https://news.google.com): Public RSS feeds used to suggest trending topics without transmitting user personal data.

    • Google Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the redactis folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins menu.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Redactis > Configurações to select your preferred AI provider and enter your API key.
  4. Click Validar Conexão to verify your API credentials.
  5. Go to Redactis > Dashboard to start generating content or exploring trending topics!
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid API subscription to use Redactis?

No. You can use Google Gemini AI Studio or Groq Cloud, which both provide generous free tiers with fast inference models.

Where are my API keys stored?

API keys are stored securely in your WordPress database options table and are never shared with third parties other than the specific AI provider you configure.

Does Redactis publish posts automatically?

By default, all generated posts are saved as Drafts (draft), allowing you to review, edit, and schedule before publishing.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Redactis automatically fills standard WordPress post excerpts, tags, categories, and injects compatible metadata for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO.
